NarutoDestination:xptoken.reference_effect: Adds chakra experience; denominations 1/5/10/50; applies general and rank multipliers before integer truncation; sneak consumes the held stack.
NarutoDestination:xptoken.target: NativeRewardItems marked vanilla paper plus NativeXpRewards calling actual NarutoMod PlayerTracker.addBattleXp.
NarutoDestination:xptoken.deliberate_adaptation: AHZNB battle XP is the target progression resource; the old base's separate chakra-experience curve is not reproduced.

NarutoDestination:sptoken.reference_effect: Adds unspent skill points; denominations 1/5/10/50; supports sneak whole-stack consumption.
NarutoDestination:sptoken.required_binding: A real allocation/respec system connected to native gameplay; do not silently turn SP into XP.

NarutoDestination:jptoken.reference_effect: Adds spendable jutsu points; supports the same four denominations and whole-stack consumption.
NarutoDestination:jptoken.required_binding: Actual jutsu acquisition/learning points; native per-jutsu mastery XP is a different mechanic and cannot be called an exact counterpart.

NarutoDestination:rpToken.reference_effect: Adds reset points for the original allocation system. It is not rank currency and does not itself immediately reset a character.
NarutoDestination:rpToken.required_binding: Real allocation reset credit tied to the supported skill system.

NarutoDestination:unidentifieddna.reference_effect: Identifies a DNA reward from the original DNA provider.
NarutoDestination:unidentifieddna.required_binding: Recover the complete original DNA identity/effect table and verify installed-provider behavior before mapping.

NarutoDestination:kgrandomizer.reference_effect: Random form rolls a specific token; specific forms grant corresponding kekkei-genkai ownership and configured token bonuses.
NarutoDestination:kgrandomizer.required_binding: Preserve roll, identity, already-owned checks and actual power acquisition; a random unrelated weapon is not equivalent.

NarutoDestination:naturerandomizer.reference_effect: Random form rolls wind/water/fire/lightning/earth/yin/yang; specific form grants that nature ownership with configured token bonuses.
NarutoDestination:naturerandomizer.required_binding: Verify actual target affinity/ownership and learning APIs for all seven outcomes.

NarutoDestination:clanrandomizer.reference_effect: Rolls or applies a specific clan through the original clan provider.
NarutoDestination:clanrandomizer.required_binding: Recover and implement each clan's actual effects, with persistence, rather than only storing a clan label.

NarutoDestination:sagerandomizer.reference_effect: Random form rolls a specific Snake/JiraiyaToad/Slug/NarutoToad/Dragon token; applying it updates sage version.
NarutoDestination:sagerandomizer.required_binding: Verify the five actual sage-mode providers and preserve specific-form acquisition and already-owned behavior.
